Mortal Shell 2 Hands-On Gameplay Impressions - It's Absolute FIRE
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking a little bit about Mortal Shell 2. Having just played the Mortal Shell 2 Beta. I absolutely loved this beta so far. and hands down. No Joke. It's one of the best betas, one of the most polished betas I've ever played for a game this early in the development.
